'''Samir Gharbo''' (13 March 1925 &ndash; 10 April 2018)<ref name="Obituary">[http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/dispatch/obituary.aspx?n=Samir-Gharbo&pid=188715493&referrer=1175&preview=True Samir Gharbo's obituary]</ref> was an Egyptian [[water polo]] player who competed in the [[1948 Summer Olympics]] and in the [[1952 Summer Olympics]].<ref name=sref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gh/samir-ahmed-gharbo-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190207015120/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gh/samir-ahmed-gharbo-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=7 February 2019 |accessdate=13 January 2018}}</ref>
